messages:
alex: heads-up — getting a flood of support tickets from a single customer in na-east: streamed responses cut off mid-stream, clients immediately reconnecting. they see one or two data chunks then connection closes.
maria: do we have an example from their logs?
alex: yes, they repro with curl to our SSE endpoint. excerpt: 
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream

data: {"id":"tok-...","choices":[{"text":"The quick brown"}]}

<socket reset> then client reconnects repeatedly and eventually hits 401 once their token rotates.
sam: two immediate checks: (1) did we emit a terminal event (like `event: done` or an empty comment) before the socket closed? (2) is this a proxy/keepalive timeout closing idle streams? jin — can you grep proxy logs for X-Redwood-Request-Id: rwd-63b2a7?
jin: pulling logs now. snippet: 
``
2026-02-18T10:01:23Z proxy[na-east]: rwd-63b2a7 upstream: 200 chunked flush=3 last-emit=10ms
2026-02-18T10:01:29Z proxy[na-east]: rwd-63b2a7 connection reset by peer (client closed) bytes_sent=412
2026-02-18T10:01:29Z lb[na-east]: rwd-63b2a7 keepalive dropped after idle=30s
```
support_jen: customer says issue began ~09:55 local and affects multiple app instances. they reported a retry spike that caused rate-limit and billing alerts.
ops_ana: noted. alex — which model were they calling? any pattern on sequence length or model family?
alex: gpt-small-avx, max_tokens=512. traffic aligned with a client release but disconnects happen across SDKs and a custom go client.
dev-bot: Incident bot: New incident created INC-2026-022 - SSE partial frames + aggressive reconnects (na-east)
oncall-bot: Escalation: @oncall-frontend paged — please ack.
oncall-frontend: ack. tcpdump shows client FIN ~6s after first data frame — looks like client is closing on seeing an initial data chunk rather than waiting for a terminal marker.
maria: could be their SSE consumer is brittle and treats the first data event as end-of-stream. support_jen, can we ask for the exact client lib/implementation?
support_jen: they attached a custom Go SSE consumer. it appears to close on any non-empty event. they did not receive `event: done` or `data: [DONE]`.
sam: mitigation plan: (A) failover routing for this customer's traffic out of na-east to na-west while we fix the root cause, (B) server-side fallback: support a `Prefer: non-stream` header that returns a non-streaming response for customers who need it, (C) short-term proxy tweaks (keepalive).
jin: starting a canary route: `rwd route update --customer-id cust-918 --region na-west --weight 10` — will shift 10% to na-west.
ops_ana: increasing proxy keepalive to 90s on na-east for streaming endpoints to reduce idle drops. applying to canary nodes: 
``
kubectl set env deployment/proxy --namespace=na-east PROXY_KEEPALIVE=90
```
alex: support_jen — advise customer devs to add exponential backoff + jitter on reconnects and to treat connection resets as retriable without immediately polling their auth service. also instruct them to check for a terminal event (`event: done`) rather than closing on first data chunk.
support_jen: relayed guidance. customer asks if server can provide a header hint to slow down reconnects like `Retry-After`.
maria: proposal: add `X-Redwood-Client-Backoff: 2000ms` as a best-effort hint on streaming responses for na-east only. engineering — okay to add as a temporary, non-guaranteed header?
sam: fine as a hint. we'll keep it behind a feature flag `stream-backoff-hint`. clients must not rely on it.
jin: patch queued to inject header at proxy for /v1/streams when `stream-backoff-hint=true`. patch log: 
``
PATCH proxy: inject header X-Redwood-Client-Backoff=2000ms for streaming endpoints
feature flag: stream-backoff-hint=true
```
dev-bot: Deploy started: proxy/na-east v2.3.5 -> v2.3.6-canary
oncall-frontend: after header canary, observed fewer rapid reconnects from the customer. their rate-limit alerts decreased. na-east still shows occasional 502/connection resets during traffic bursts.
ops_ana: preliminary hypothesis: intermittent worker OOMs in runtime causing abrupt socket termination before final flush — correlates with heavy KV cache GC during high prefix reuse.
alex: runtime team — can you reproduce? sam/jin?
sam: built a repro harness: concurrent long-lived streams with prefix reuse triggers cache churn; reproduced a worker heap spike followed by SIGPIPE on socket writes. created runtime ticket R-9843 with heap profile and traces.
support_jen: customer requested ETA and temporary SLA workaround — asked to move all traffic to na-west.
ops_ana: can do; warn them latency ~+30ms.
support_jen: customer accepted. applying 100% route change: `rwd route update --customer-id cust-918 --region na-west --weight 100` — propagation ~12s.
jin: route update complete.
oncall-frontend: monitoring: reconnect/retry spike normalized after full failover to na-west.
sam: opened PR to change kv-cache eviction and reduce concurrent cache pressure: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8423 — canary deployed to runtime/nodepool-2.
dev-bot: Canary deploy success on runtime/nodepool-2 — no OOMs observed in 2h with steady load.
sam: planning full rollout in 1h if no regressions.
ops_ana: we'll keep proxy keepalive=90s for 24h then reassess. documenting revert plan in playbook.
support_jen: billing_ana — customer was rate-limited and incurred charges due to aggressive retries; can billing review for a possible reversal?
billing_ana: acknowledged — need request ids and customer consent; support_jen uploaded logs and consent form.
alex: action items: 1) runtime: land GC/kv-cache mitigation (owner: sam) and roll out; 2) ops: keepalive increase for 24h (owner: ops_ana); 3) proxy: stream-backoff-hint enabled for 48h (owner: jin); 4) support: billing reversal request for cust-918 (owner: support_jen). update thread on completion.
dev-bot: Incident INC-2026-022 status -> mitigated -> monitoring
support_jen: customer confirms stability on na-west and will wait for full rollout before switching back. closing their escalation ticket.
alex: I'll write a short status page update: mitigations (na-west failover for cust-918, proxy keepalive increased, backoff hint header, runtime fix canary passed). ETA full resolution: 3-6 hours.
maria: assigning postmortem owner: sam. if more customers surface, bump severity to P1.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-022 marked monitoring.
alex: closing internal incident when full rollout completes. will attach timeline + postmortem in incidents/.
